name: kitesail_corsair_no_flying_on_defense
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'This creature has flying as long as it's attacking.' Seat 1's turn: Opp Bird (flying) attacks. Seat 0's untapped Kitesail Corsair is not attacking, so it has no flying (and no reach) and is never offered to block the Bird; seat 0 takes 1.
